production_rules: Production renders exactly three locked 1080x1620 portrait pages.
Header, approved STACORP logo, date lockup and navy/gold footer are immutable inside V3.
The brief contains exactly eight qualified news items focused on MIỀN BẮC and MIỀN TRUNG: at least three per region and no more than two TOÀN QUỐC items.
Standalone southern-region items are excluded; only nationwide developments with direct material impact on North/Central operations may appear as TOÀN QUỐC.
Page 1 presents story 1 as the hero plus stories 2-4 as three readable horizontal news rows.
Page 2 presents stories 5-8 as a 2x2 regional news grid with headline, one fact and a short STACORP note.
Page 3 never repeats the eight headlines. It synthesizes four cross-department impact groups, North/Central regional pulse, exactly three 24-48h watchpoints and eight compact source references.
summary_lede must be 140-240 characters; department_digest must contain exactly four groups; regional_pulse exactly MIỀN BẮC and MIỀN TRUNG; watchpoints exactly three.
ChatGPT Images creates exactly eight story illustrations only; it must never generate final newsletter pages, text, logo, badge or watermark.
Every story visual must pass the original-source quality gate before rendering; preview/thumbnail WEBP files are blocked.
Source visuals require PNG/JPEG, long edge >=1400, short edge >=900, source bytes >=250,000 and sharpness >=18.0.

If direct original bytes cannot be committed, delivery may provide visual_sources.json containing exactly eight original ChatGPT Images oaiusercontent.com /raw URLs for immediate download by GitHub Actions.
Final pages are always rendered deterministically from the locked HTML/CSS templates.
Teams delivery uses a 1200x1800 high-density master and deterministic JPEG 4:4:4 transport within the Graph message payload budget.
Each Teams page must remain within the deterministic page budget and the three-page binary total must not exceed 2,550,000 bytes.
Template hash, logo hash, output dimensions and geometry must pass before Teams posting.
Any source visual, copy schema, regional-balance or geometry failure blocks render, Teams posting and state update.
No fallback template is allowed; Teams transport may only step through the locked JPEG quality ladder 97→90.
Layout changes require explicit user approval and a new layout version.

delivery_modes: visual_sources.json with eight original ChatGPT Images /raw URLs

editorial_scope.south_exception: Only a nationwide development with direct material impact on North/Central operations may be included and must be tagged TOÀN QUỐC.
